environment_basis: Two explicit contexts: preserved provider-sandbox observations and selected host CPU profile; neither implies end-to-end success.

status_definitions.implemented: Current source implementation was inspected; this is not an end-to-end result.
status_definitions.documented-only: A guide/adapter/interface exists but no callable sealed route was established.
status_definitions.fixture-only: A mock or test-only surface exists and cannot support a research claim.
status_definitions.unsupported: The requested route is absent or explicitly outside audited support.
status_definitions.unavailable: A requested route cannot run in the sealed environment because a required dependency, service, or resource is absent.
